# CPA BOCA RATON

## Welcome to Jeffrey D. Ressler,   CPA & Associates

## Expert Accounting Services from Boca Raton’s Trusted CPA

Jeffrey D. Ressler is a Certified Public Accountant with a boutique, full-service accounting firm in Boca Raton, Florida. At **Jeffrey D. Ressler, CPA & Associates**, we believe accounting isn’t just about numbers—it’s about empowering your financial future with clarity, confidence, and strategic insight.

Our CPA firm provides individuals, entrepreneurs, and small-to-midsize businesses with precision-driven accounting, taxation, and financial advisory services. Whether you’re navigating tax season or scaling a business, our firm offers the professional rigor of a national consultancy with the personal touch of a neighborhood expert.

### Advantages of Working with Our CPA Firm

For business owners who are already overburdened with all the other responsibilities of running a company, hiring our CPA firm can be quite helpful. Employing a CPA firm allows small business owners to concentrate on their other business operations by freeing up their time and relieving them of those duties.

Certified Public Accountants (CPAs) are responsible for staying current on laws that frequently change over time. If your company doesn’t adapt to these changes, the IRS may punish or even prosecute you. Because our CPA (Jeffrey D. Ressler) knows how to take advantage of tax benefits and credits that you might not be aware of, his knowledge and experience can also help you save money.

Generally speaking, hiring an internal accounting team or accountant is more expensive than hiring a third-party CPA firm. Though you might not get it from an in-house team, CPA firms usually offer an alternative viewpoint due to their level of expertise working with various kinds of businesses.

**CALL US**

**561-237-5264**

#### How Can We Help?

## The Differences between a CPA and an Accountant

A Certified Public Accountant (CPA) is an accountant licensed to offer accounting, tax planning, auditing, and consulting services to organizations. This is the primary distinction between CPA firms and accounting firms. They are involved in estate planning as well.

The states in which CPAs practice have strict regulatory requirements that they must adhere to. Before obtaining a license, one must meet certain qualifications, such as passing the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and possessing a Bachelor’s degree (although other states may have more stringent requirements).

On the flip side, accountants usually just offer bookkeeping and tax preparation services and do not have a CPA license. Although not necessary or required, certain accounting firms may employ people with CPA designations.

Accountants aren’t all CPAs. All CPAs, nevertheless, are also qualified to represent clients before tax authorities such as the Internal Revenue Service. Thus, it’s recommended to choose a CPA firm if you’re looking for a complete financial solution for your company. They have the expertise and knowledge to help with tax strategies and support the expansion and success of your company.

![](https://jrcpa.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Our-CPA-Services-1.jpg)

## Comprehensive Core CPA Services

[**Tax Planning**](https://jrcpa.net/tax-preparation/)

- Strategic tax minimization planning
- Estate, gift, and trust tax filing and compliance
- Financial forecasting and budgeting

[**Income Tax Preparation**](https://jrcpa.net/tax-preparation/)

- Individual and business tax returns (Federal and State)
- Sales tax returns
- Estate, gift, and trust tax compliance

[**Help With IRS**](https://jrcpa.net/help-with-irs/)

- IRS representation and audit defense
- Get up to date on unfiled tax returns
- Resolutions for tax debts and liens

[**Company Formation**](https://jrcpa.net/company-formation/)

- Business entity structuring and reorganization
- LLC and corporate formation
- M&A due diligence and valuation

[**Payroll Service**](https://jrcpa.net/payroll/)

- Direct Deposit or manual paycheck payment options
- Full compliance with payroll laws
- Employee logins for check stub retrieval

[**Bookkeeping Service**](https://jrcpa.net/bookkeeping/)

- Full-cycle accounting and monthly reconciliations
- QuickBooks setup and management
- Cash flow and profitability analysis

[Call us Today](tel:561-237-5264)

### Why Choose Us?

- Depth of experience with over 25 years serving clients across industries
- Individualized service, customized for your goals
- Strategic financial insights
- Integrity, Accuracy, and Confidentiality
- Accessible for questions
- Solutions specific to your individual or business needs
- Personal, quality service
- Serving Boca Raton and beyond - Palm Beach County & nationwide

## CPA Services

Tax preparation is only one of our comprehensive accounting services. Tax returns and help with tax forms for individuals as well as businesses, trusts, and estates are done by expert tax accountants, and you can schedule a consultation for business planning, starting a new business, and financial planning. Our clients are welcome to call our office any time with questions.

### Our Accountants Tailor Solutions to Your Needs

Our Certified Public Accountant and specialized accounting team have many years of experience and dedication to providing the best client service with the most up-to-date tax information on all tax changes. That means minimizing your liabilities, providing a plan for your finances based on the newest tax laws, and finding solutions specific to your individual and business needs.

### Contact Us

Clients come to us not just from Boca Raton, but from all over Florida, and many areas across the United States. Most of them have been with us for many years without ever coming into our local office in Boca. With today’s technologies, we are able to communicate effectively and maintain a positive, professional client relationship, which is one of our firm’s top priorities.

### Call our office today to set-up an appointment and get started – 561-237-5264

#### Our Mission

Our mission is to build long-lasting client relationships based on trust, and provide consulting and support to help you achieve your goals. Our work ethic, high standards, and commitment to their financial well-being are why our clients stay with us year after year.

Jeffrey D. Ressler, CPA & Associates in Boca Raton, FL, provides services to clients throughout southern Florida, including Deerfield Beach, Delray Beach, Coral Springs, Margate, Pompano Beach, and Boynton Beach.
